duplicateExecutionAccounting.policy: Never sum historical windows or duplicate verify unit passes into new/final coverage. XML suite counts are per window; log-only upstream unit results are not retained XML.
duplicateExecutionAccounting.distinctCaseCaveat: Identity union only, includes red and obsolete source; not a final passed case count.

conclusions: Retain exact failed XML and setup-error windows; directory names do not determine outcome.
saved-graph-red is XML error; saved-graph-behavior-red is XML assertion failure. Both include duplicate 39-suite/244-case upstream unit passes in logs.
fresh-jvm-01 and future-capabilities-red-01 remain actual failed historical windows in the initial snapshot; no later completion inferred.
MAVEN_CONFIG explicit non-null receipts record suppression flags; explicit null records unset; missing fields remain unknown despite XML showing effective suppression.
Passing historical stages do not prove current or final source. Per-window hashes and bounded current deltas are retained. Final Task6 receipt/source custody still pending.
limitations: No test execution, behavior/source review, complete qualification audit, credentials/env reads or DB/resource inspection.
Current files can change concurrently after capture, and snapshot cannot establish later state.
Only artifacts complete at initial inventory are audited.
Historical source.json is a pre-run map, not independently run-end rehashed source proof.
Contract/dependency receipts have no backend sourceWindow or XML; command exit receipts alone do not seal current contract/generated files.
